name: orchyn
title: Orchyn — social intelligence
description: Social intelligence for Claude. Read posts, spoken transcripts, comments, creators, trending sounds and hashtags across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, Reddit, LinkedIn, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Weibo and Bilibili — monitor every comment that names your brand across nine of them at once — then act on what you learn: write hooks, create variants to film, score a draft before you publish, and repurpose a post for other surfaces. 28 tools, OAuth 2.1, billed in orchyn credits (20 free to start).
